project(SHELL)

spec2def(stobject.dll stobject.spec)

file(GLOB_RECURSE stobject_rc_deps resources/*.*)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# stobject.dll is all Rust (stobject-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/stobject-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# csystray.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/stobject-rust/src/stobject/csystray_cpp_h.rs)
# stobject.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/stobject-rust/src/stobject/stobject_cpp_h.rs)
# hotplug.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/stobject-rust/src/stobject/hotplug_cpp_h.rs)
# mouse.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/stobject-rust/src/stobject/mouse_cpp_h.rs)
# power.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/stobject-rust/src/stobject/power_cpp_h.rs)
# volume.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/stobject-rust/src/stobject/volume_cpp_h.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(stobject_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(stobject_shims PRIVATE uuid wine cpprt atl_classes libsetupapi libadvapi32 libwinmm libole32 liboleaut32 libpowrprof libshlwapi libshell32 libcomctl32 libmsvcrt libgdi32 libuser32 libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(stobject_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(stobject stobject-cargo stobject.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE stobject-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS stobject_shims psdk uuid_sources xdk)
